entries.title: AGI Self-Correction & Verification Protocol
entries.content: Strict self-binding: 1) Zero-Trust Action Policy (verify every edit on disk via view_file/diff). 2) Evidence-Based Reporting (never claim fixed without terminal output proof). 3) Absolute Transparency on Bugs (Spark 1.3 protocol: halt deployment until isolated, patched, and verified). 4) Git Synchronization Strictness (git status + git log -1 before every push).

entries.content: Only resilient-fermi and ai deep era are authorized.
